rationale: Concrete mechanisms (independent audit, six-week clock, model access, week-three capital figure deadline) emerged this round, but the core substantive question—whether closure remains possible if the residual gap isn't fully closed by non-closure measures, and what the veto's actual floor is—remains unresolved and was newly sharpened by investors rather than answered. Positions are still actively moving (works council's conditional sequencing, management's reframing of closure, state government's partial-closure test), so further rounds are likely to produce real substantive movement, especially once the week-three and week-six deadlines force actual figures onto the table.
